dataset: synthetic_demo (500 customers after cleaning, standardized RFM with log1p)
note: Metrics only when 2 <= n_clusters < N after excluding noise. Not UCI results.
selection_rationale: Under the project's fixed default min_samples=5 on standardized synthetic RFM, eps=0.40 yields a higher Silhouette (0.4395, 7 clusters, 2.8% noise) than eps=0.45 (0.3959, 5 clusters, 1.0% noise). eps=0.45 was still retained as the project default because it sits in the middle of the useful density band (approx 0.40-0.50), produces fewer micro-clusters (5 vs 7), keeps noise at about 1%, and avoids the single-cluster collapse observed at eps=0.65. The earlier grid peak at eps=0.40/min_samples=8 (Silhouette 0.5054) required changing min_samples and was not adopted as the default pair. Selection was not made to maximize Silhouette. K-Means++ remains the primary recommended model; DBSCAN defaults are starting points and remain data-dependent.
recommendation: K-Means++ remains the primary model. DBSCAN eps is data-dependent.
honesty_note: eps=0.40 with min_samples=5 has a higher Silhouette than the chosen default. The default prioritizes a moderate cluster count and very low noise over pure Silhouette maximization.
